headline: A 1995 executive order made further changes to Executive Order 12852, an earlier order that set up a presidential advisory council.
what_it_does: This order changes the text of Executive Order 12852, which had been changed before. Order 12852, from 1993, is generally known for creating the President's Council on Sustainable Development. The title alone does not say what was changed. It may involve how the council is set up or how long it lasts.

who_it_affects.group: Members and staff of the advisory council created by Executive Order 12852
who_it_affects.how: The order changes the rules for their council, but the title does not say which rules.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on June 27, 1995 (not stated in the source material).
